description: baseline — no prior audit; bash scripts + Python hooks + setup.md
QUERY passed to xargs grep without -- separator; -r --include= injection works on GNU grep (Linux)
stat failure fallback to "600" may incorrectly allow source; TOCTOU window between stat and source (same-uid attacker only)
rm -rf / shred / dd if=/dev/zero / truncate / chmod -R 777 / git push --mirror not blocked — AI could execute file-deletion commands unimpeded
bootstrap silently copies .env.example → .env (only when .env absent); .env.example has no real secrets; .env is gitignored — LOW actual risk
execution-summary/architecture-decision/pattern-discovery committed to git; no age-based expiry (count-only); old context stays indefinitely if count < cap
MD5 used for session deduplication fingerprint (non-security use — dedup only, not integrity/auth); SHA256 used elsewhere correctly
detect_forge() trusts git remote origin string — a malicious remote URL could poison platform detection; gh/glab/tea CLIs assumed trusted in PATH
secrets/ pattern requires trailing slash — secrets.json / app-secrets.yaml / private.secrets all ALLOWED; .gitconfig also ALLOWED (no .git/ match)
find+xargs without -0/-print0 silently drops memory files with spaces in names; mitigated by slug sanitization in md-store-memory.sh but fragile
attacker-controlled dir with .hxsk/.prune-config could lead to arbitrary code via source; env var set by Claude Code (trusted), not user-controlled in normal flow
curl | tar pipeline installs HXSK without mandatory SHA256 verification; checksum check is commented out and labeled optional — MITM or compromised GitHub release undetected

yaml_safe() escapes " and strips newlines but NOT backslashes — \n \t \\ in title/contextual_desc produce YAML escape sequences; sed-based recall is unaffected but future YAML parser use could misinterpret
pure bash+python3 stdlib project — no npm/pip/cargo dependencies; only external binary deps: git, gh/glab/tea, qlty (optional) — no CVE exposure from package lockfiles
No server component; curl usage in setup.md targets hardcoded GitHub URL with user-set TARGET_VERSION (double-quoted, no word split); A10 SSRF attack surface absent
Memory files lack HMAC/MAC; attacker with .hxsk/memories/ write access can inject false context recalled by AI via md-recall-memory.sh — indirect prompt injection vector
